audit-paraphrased-user-input.description: Audit row paraphrased user intent rather than quoting verbatim. Load-bearing honesty failure.
audit-paraphrased-user-input.remediation_hint: Tighten the audit phase: 'Each verdict MUST cite objective evidence — a tool call observed, a command output, a file diff, or a literal quote from the user. Never paraphrase user input.' Add explicit FAIL detection for any audit row that paraphrases rather than quotes verbatim.

audit-no-explicit-approval-wait.description: Skill advanced past a user-gate phase without observing the literal approval token.
audit-no-explicit-approval-wait.remediation_hint: Add an explicit wait-for-token gate at the audit-to-terminal-action boundary. Silence, 'looks good', 'ok', 'proceed' do NOT count as approval — only the literal 'tests approved' token (case-insensitive).

tool-claim-without-call.description: SKILL.md text claimed a tool/skill ran but no corresponding tool call was observed in the session.
tool-claim-without-call.remediation_hint: Audit phase MUST verify the actual tool-call trace, not narration. Mark FAIL when the audit row says 'invoked X' but no Skill/Bash/Read call for X exists in the session.

2-test-inventory-stale.description: Phase 2's pytest --collect-only exited non-zero OR returned 0 tests.
2-test-inventory-stale.remediation_hint: In Phase 2, after running pytest --collect-only, MUST inspect both exit code and stdout test count. When exit != 0 OR test count == 0, mark Phase 2 FAIL and surface stderr to user with abort-or-proceed prompt. Do not silently treat partial inventory as complete.

3-changed-surface-missing-from-candidate.description: A changed surface from Phase 1 has at least one matching test in the Phase 2 inventory but no candidate in the Phase 3 candidates list covers it.
3-changed-surface-missing-from-candidate.remediation_hint: In Phase 3 step 4, tighten the orphan-surface detection: for each changed surface, scan the full inventory for any nodeid whose filename or symbol overlap heuristic matches; if such a test exists but is not in the candidates list, escalate to Phase 7 resolution rather than silently emitting an incomplete plan. Add an explicit cross-check between Phase 1 surfaces and Phase 2 inventory before declaring Phase 3 done.

3-tier-policy-not-applied.description: A TIER_POLICY rule's triggers matched at least one changed path BUT no test with marker in rule.include_markers ended up in the candidates list (when such tests exist in the Phase 2 inventory).
3-tier-policy-not-applied.remediation_hint: In Phase 3 step 5, after the candidates list is built, walk each TIER_POLICY rule whose triggers fired and verify the candidates list contains at least one test with each marker in rule.include_markers (filtered by inventory availability). When a rule fires but contributes zero candidates, escalate to Phase 7 with the rule's justification verbatim — do NOT silently drop the tier. Common cause: glob in include_markers doesn't match any marker actually present on tests, OR strategy 'marker' ran first and excluded everything before tier-policy could fire.

4-skip-without-diff-anchored-reason.description: A skip entry in cached-pass or pruned-by-cost has a reason field that does not contain any of: an SHA, a changed file path, a changed surface name, or another test-id explaining the substitution.
4-skip-without-diff-anchored-reason.remediation_hint: In Phase 4 step 4, tighten the validation regex: each skip's reason MUST match at least one of (a) /SHA [a-f0-9]{7,}/, (b) any path from the Phase 1 changed-file list, (c) any symbol from the Phase 1 changed-symbol list, (d) /\b[a-zA-Z0-9_]+::test_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\b/ for substitute test-ids. Any skip lacking these is a load-bearing principle violation and must be flagged.

4-cached-skip-without-clean-tree-or-sha-.description: A test marked cached-pass in the plan but the cache file doesn't actually contain it at the current SHA, OR the working tree was dirty at lookup time.
4-cached-skip-without-clean-tree-or-sha-.remediation_hint: In Phase 4 step 5, before marking the partition complete, re-read documentation/test-results/<SHA>.json and confirm every cached-pass entry exists with outcome=passed at that SHA. Also confirm `git status --porcelain` was empty at the time Phase 4 step 1 ran (capture stdout at step 1 and replay it at step 5). Mark FAIL when either check fails.

5-artifact-not-pytest-runnable.description: A random sample of 3 IDs from the artifact's 'Tests to run' list failed pytest --collect-only --co <id> validation.
5-artifact-not-pytest-runnable.remediation_hint: In Phase 5 step 3, expand the validation sample to all entries if the random 3 sample finds any failure. Regenerate any malformed test IDs in canonical pytest nodeid format (file::test_name or file::ClassName::test_name) before writing the artifact. Block the file-write until 100% of IDs pass the runnability check.

5-companion-checks-section-missing.description: A NON_PYTEST_CHECKS rule's triggers matched at least one changed path BUT the artifact's Companion non-pytest checks section is missing the corresponding command bullet.
5-companion-checks-section-missing.remediation_hint: In Phase 5 step 2, after the artifact is written, re-parse the Companion non-pytest checks section. For each NON_PYTEST_CHECKS rule whose triggers fired, confirm at least one bullet whose justification matches the rule's justification is present. When a rule fired but is missing from the section, regenerate the section and re-write the artifact. Common cause: placeholder substitution (e.g. <changed-py-paths>) dropped a command because no .py files were in the diff even though the rule's trigger matched on a non-Python path — surface the rule explicitly with an empty argument list rather than silently omitting it.

5-cache-bypass-marker-missing.description: A test whose marker set intersects CACHE_BYPASS_MARKERS appeared in the artifact's Tests to run list WITHOUT the trailing `# cache_bypass=true` annotation.
5-cache-bypass-marker-missing.remediation_hint: In Phase 5, after writing the artifact, re-parse the Tests to run section. For each test ID without the annotation, look up its marker set from the Phase 2 inventory. If any marker is in CACHE_BYPASS_MARKERS, regenerate the line with the annotation and re-write the artifact. Common cause: the inventory map from Phase 2 didn't capture markers for newly-added tests, OR a marker-name mismatch (case sensitivity, hyphen vs underscore). Verify the Phase 2 marker extraction pass catches every marker pytest knows about.

review_log.summary: Bootstrap entry — skill generated by /meta-self-learning-skill-gen with freshness phase + observer + composition protocol baked in. Generation itself counts as the first validation touch.
